capabilities.title: Coding Agent Orchestrator
capabilities.description: Bind an explicitly activated coding objective to deterministic .CAO state while native Codex owns execution topology.

runtimeBinding.instruction: Activate only from an explicit CAO request or explicit active-workflow continuation. Bind .CAO to the exact root thread, use official Hooks for immediate root and descendant events, use official app-server readback for ancestry and collaboration reconciliation, and keep runtime observations separate from semantic work, evidence, acceptance, finalization, and handoff. Never launch workers, select models, prescribe topology, flatten descendants, or infer semantic completion from runtime completion.

authorityRequests.reason: CAO is opt-in and must not bind state from directory presence alone.
CAO writes deterministic untracked state under the selected jobsite .CAO directory.
Official Hook payloads and app-server readback establish exact session-tree and collaboration facts.
